subject: history
concept: Writing an evidence-based essay analyzing an empire's rise, governance, or decline, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans their essay using a claim/evidence/analysis organizer
exercise.abstract: Student writes an essay analyzing an aspect of an empire's rise, governance, or decline, supported by specific evidence

assessment.mastery_threshold: essay makes a clear claim supported by specific historical evidence
misconception_flags: summarizes historical events without making an analytical claim about them

interest_binding: empire/topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile where possible
